data.name: Conrade
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German elements 'kun' (war) and 'rat' (counsel). Conrad means 'brave counselor'. This name was popular among medieval knights and crusaders.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing courage and wisdom.

in_hebrew.name: קונראד
in_hebrew.meaning: איש חסיד,  מאורגן,  מאוחד,  חבר,  שותף,  נאמן,  צדק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור תחילת השם הוא הגרמנית,  היה נפוץ באירופה בעת הביניימית,  פירושו איש חסיד או  מאורגן.  ראוי לציין  שהשם  קונראד  נמצא  בספר  המקרא  (1  סמואל  31:2),  בהקשר  של  אחד  הבנים  של  שאול,  נבחר  לירוש המלכות.  בנוסף,  השם  נעשה  פופולרי בערך במאה  ה-11,  שם  של  קיסר  האימפריה  הרומית  הקדושה,  1014-1039,   הקיסר  הראשון  שהפך  את  הכנסייה  הקתולית  לדומיננטית  באירופה.  באופן  כללי,  השם  קונראד  יכול  לסמל  נאמנות,  חברות  וצדק.

in_greek.name: Κωνραδος
in_greek.meaning: εγκαρδιας,  ευγενης,  χερεσ,  πιστος,  αμοιβαος,  ομοιωτος
in_greek.long_meaning: η προέλευση του ονόματος Κόνραδος είναι γερμανική,  η οποία ήταν δημοφιλής στην Ευρώπη κατά την μεσαιωνική εποχή.  Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος αναφέρεται σε μια προσωπικότητα που είναι εγκαρδιας, ευγενής, χέρες, πιστός, αμοιβαίος, ομοιωτός.  Είναι αξιοσημείωτο ότι το όνομα Κόνραδος αναφέρετε στην Βίβλο (1 Σαμουήλ 31:2),  στον έτερον γιο του Σαούλ,  ο οποίος εξελέγη για να διαδεχθεί τον πατέρα του.  Επίσης,  το όνομα έγινε δημοφιλές γύρω στο 11ο αιώνα,  ως όνομα του Αυτοκράτορα της Αγίας Ρωμαϊκής Αυτοκρατορίας,  Κωνσταντίνος Β',  1014-1039,  ο οποίος ήταν ο πρώτος Αυτοκράτορας που έκανε την Καθολική Εκκλησία την κυρίαρχη στην Ευρώπη.  Γενικά,  το όνομα Κόνραδος μπορεί να συμβολίζει πίστη,  σωστό,  αμοιβαίο,  ομοιωμένο.

in_latin.name: Conradus
in_latin.meaning: fidelis,  generosus,  bonus,  amicus,  socius,  fidelis,  congruus
in_latin.long_meaning: Origo nominis Conradus est Germanica,  qui fuit in usu Europa medio aevo.  Etymologia nominis referre potest ad personam quae fidelis,  generosus,  bonus,  amicus,  socius,  fidelis,  congruus est.  Notandum est quod nomen Conradus in Biblia (1 Samuelis 31:2) apparet,  in contextu adoptionis filii Salomonis regem.  Etiam nomen factum est populaire circa annum 1100,  ut nomen Imperatoris Romanorum Sanctae Ecclesiae,  Conradus II,  1014-1039,  qui fuit primus Imperator qui Ecclesiam Catholicam in Europa dominare fecit.  Generalmente,  nomen Conradus potest significare fidelitatem,  bonitatem,  amicitiam,  coniunctionem.

in_english.name: Conrade
in_english.meaning: loyal,  noble,  good,  friend,  companion,  faithful,  harmonious
in_english.long_meaning: The origin of the name Conrade is Germanic,  which was popular in Europe during the Middle Ages.  The etymology of the name refers to a personality that is loyal,  noble,  good,  a friend,  a companion,  faithful,  harmonious.  Notably,  the name Conrade appears in the Bible (1 Samuel 31:2),  in the context of the adoption of Solomon's son as king.  Also,  the name became popular around the 11th century,  as the name of the Holy Roman Emperor,  Conrad II,  1014-1039,  who was the first emperor to make the Catholic Church dominant in Europe.  Generally,  the name Conrade can signify loyalty,  goodness,  friendship,  harmony.

data.cultural_impact: The Christian name Conrad has a rich cultural and historical significance, originating from the Old German language. The name speaks to the noble character of bravery and wise counsel, which were highly valued traits for medieval knights and crusaders. The name became prevalent during the Middle Ages and was given to boys in honor of their potential to grow up to be brave warriors and wise leaders. The Crusades played a significant role in the popularization of the name, as many Crusaders bore the name in their quest for religious and territorial conquest.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Conrad lies in its implication of fearless courage and wise counsel in God's service. The name suggests a person of strong character who is not only brave in battle but also wise in decision-making and counseling others. In Christian tradition, Conrad can be seen as a reminder of the call to be a faithful servant of God, standing bravely in the face of adversity and providing wise counsel to those around us. The name Conrad reminds us of the importance of trusting in God's guidance and strength, as we step forward in courage to serve Him and others.
